cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The office clock is dragging us backward. Excellent, we can attend the meeting we missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Too far. I haven't received the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Extra preparation time. This clock understands workload.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's before the booking. The boss wants my opinion: do we need this meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Tell her no. We've upgraded from attending on time to giving everyone their afternoon back.

mechanism: A uses backward time as a succession of benefits to its former pupil meeting habits, finally coaching a refusal that prevents the meeting.
confusable: Not merely planning around a mishap: every additional reversal is actively praised for an advantage it newly supplies.
comparison: Picnic resource gathering versus office pupil moving beyond obedient attendance.
seedUse: D164 backward clock/missing invitation/boss before booking; S05 diary and speaking-up lessons.
